artifact_observations.reasoning: The intricate blue and gold patterns on the front of the altar lack sharp micro-definition upon close inspection, appearing slightly 'painted' or smeared rather than having distinct tile or stone edges. This is a common AI artifact in complex repetitive patterns.
The base of the right-hand candlestick seems to merge slightly with the altar cloth and lacks a clear, distinct contact shadow or physical grounding point, appearing to float slightly.

The vertical lines of the Gothic arches in the background show slight warping and inconsistency in perspective convergence, though this could also be attributed to wide-angle lens distortion in real photography.
